resources.string: One-finger swipes from the four screen edges, like on an iPhone. You can choose any action for each swipe.
Swipe with one finger from an edge of the screen. A short and a long swipe each run an action of your choice. Touches that start at an edge are not read aloud.
From the left edge, upper half of the screen
From the left edge, lower half of the screen
From the right edge, upper half of the screen
From the right edge, lower half of the screen
Say Home, Back, Recents, Notifications, Quick settings or another action when the swipe is long enough for it.
Play rising tones while the finger moves, a higher tone when an action is reached.
Actions for the volume up and down keys
Read new notifications aloud, choose what is said, and whether to read them when the screen is off. Incoming calls are always read.
What to read in a notification
Choose which parts of a notification are read, together or separately.
Shows a short message for every key press that reaches Nika: what the key is and whether it was used. Turn it on to find out why a key does not work.
